blockers.detail: CLIENT-WALKENHORST migrated its browser export core from realtime MediaRecorder/captureStream to deterministic WebMotion/WebCodecs. DG-MAIN currently has no lib/studio-v3-browser-render-core.ts or equivalent browser render seam to adapt safely without creating a parallel Studio architecture. No Walkenhorst runtime data, credentials, branding or customer logic were copied.

DG-MAIN now exposes and requires the Vercel preview URL in its Website Build Stream. CLIENT-WALKENHORST has no Website Build Stream, website_projects model, or equivalent route to adapt without creating a new unrequested product surface.

rules: Never replace the established Pflege UX with a new parallel dashboard to port a shared feature.
Adapt shared behavior into the existing Pflege surface.
Never create a second primary Pflege workspace; /pro must resolve back to the canonical root workspace.
Never lower the Pflege A+ qualification gate merely to fill the daily lead target; expose the deficit and keep searching instead.
Never copy customer data, credentials, Supabase refs, branding or industry-specific logic between instances.
Do not mark a shared-core task complete until both instances are adapted or a blocker is recorded here.
